doc:
Governance module for the MySocial network
 Manages the decentralized governance system with delegate council and community assembly
 Implements proposal submission, voting, and execution processes

 Delegate panel refresh runs inside [`try_update_delegate_panel_if_due`], which is invoked from
 `update_delegate_panel` and piggybacked on delegate-election flows (nominations,
 `vote_for_delegate` / `clear_vote_for_delegate`), proposal submission, delegate **proposal** review
 votes ([`run_delegate_review_vote`]), and community **finalize** ([`finalize_community_voting_internals`]).
 Community voting entries ([`community_vote_on_proposal`]) intentionally do not trigger refresh.
 A refresh applies when the epoch has reached at least one full `delegate_term_epochs` boundary and
 that boundary has not been applied yet (catch-up: e.g. epoch 93 applies boundary 90 if still pending).
 Refresh is lazy until one of those transactions runs while eligible; use a keeper if you need a
 strict wall-clock guarantee when governance is idle.

bootstrap_init.doc:
Bootstrap initialization function - creates the governance registries.
 Returns the shared SPoT governance registry object ID for wiring into [`social_contracts::social_proof_of_truth`].

seed_founding_delegate.doc: Install the founding delegate without going through nomination (bootstrap / platform creation).

update_governance_parameters_internal.doc:
Update governance parameters (internal function)
 This function does not perform authorization checks - callers must verify permissions

update_platform_governance_parameters.doc:
Update governance parameters for platform registries
 Can only be called by the platform module (which verifies platform ownership)
 This function is package-private to prevent direct calls that bypass platform ownership verification

update_governance_parameters.doc:
Update governance parameters for ecosystem/proof-of-creativity registries
 Can only be called by governance admin

nominate_delegate.doc:
Nominate self as a delegate
 Uses wallet-level architecture - no profile required

vote_for_delegate.doc:
Vote for or against a delegate or nominee delegate
 Positive votes support the delegate, negative votes express disapproval
 Users can change their vote at any time

clear_vote_for_delegate.doc:
Remove the caller's up or down vote on a delegate or nominee (neutral / undo).
 Aborts with `ENoExistingVote` if the caller has not voted on this target.

try_update_delegate_panel_if_due.doc:
When `ctx.epoch()` has reached a completed term boundary that has not yet been applied,
 recomputes the delegate council from incumbents and nominees. Otherwise returns immediately.

update_delegate_panel.doc: Updates delegate panel at the end of a delegate term cycle (keeper / manual backstop).

submit_proposal.doc:
Universal function to submit any type of proposal
 Handles proposal types: ecosystem and proof of creativity

submit_ecosystem_proposal.doc:
Submit a new proposal to the ecosystem registry
 Requires staking MYSO tokens equal to the proposal submission cost

submit_proof_of_creativity_proposal.doc: Submit a proof of creativity proposal

submit_spot_resolution_proposal.doc: Submit a SPoT resolution proposal (binary ratification of one outcome for a contested market).

submit_spot_proposal_and_return_id.doc: Package helper: submit a SPoT resolution proposal and return its ID.

rescind_proposal.doc: Allow a proposal owner to rescind their proposal if it's still in the delegate review stage

move_to_community_voting.doc: Move a proposal to community voting phase

community_vote_on_proposal.doc:
Community vote on a proposal with quadratic voting
 Users can cast multiple votes by paying a quadratically increasing cost

community_vote_anonymous.doc: Submit an anonymous encrypted vote on a proposal

transition_proposal_rejected_by_delegate.doc: Updates status tables only: delegate review to rejected. Caller sends pool + emits [ProposalRejectedEvent].

complete_delegate_reject_drain_to_platfo.doc: For platform: transition + forfeiture event (platform route) + [ProposalRejectedEvent]; returns pool balance for the caller to join into `Platform.treasury`.

run_delegate_review_vote.doc: Run delegate-in-review vote logic; returns 0=still in review, 1=advanced to community, 2=must complete delegate reject (ecosystem or platform) via separate entry.

delegate_vote_on_proposal.doc: Ecosystem and proof-of-creativity only: `ecosystem_treasury` used when the delegate council rejects the proposal.

finalize_proposal.doc: Ecosystem and proof-of-creativity: finalize after community vote; on failure, reward pool to ecosystem treasury.

forfeit_proposal_pool_after_community_re.doc: After community voting fails for a platform registry: move funds into this platform’s governance (treasury) balance.

anonymous_tally_votes_and_finalize_commu.doc: Decrypt anonymous votes, merge tallies, and resolve community finalization. Callable from [`social_contracts::platform`] for platform registries.

finalize_proposal_anonymous.doc: Finalize a proposal with anonymous votes by decrypting them first (ecosystem / proof-of-creativity only).

mark_proposal_implemented_take_pool.doc: Shared implementation transition + drains `reward_pool` for routing by the caller.

mark_proposal_implemented_to_ecosystem_t.doc: Mark implemented: reward the submitter with the implementation pool (ecosystem or proof-of-creativity registry).

mark_proposal_implemented_platform_to_ec.doc: Mark implemented: platform registry when the linked [`Platform`] is not in the transaction — still pays the proposer.

proposal_type_platform_value.doc: Registry type discriminator for platform routing (see [`social_contracts::platform`]).

get_proposals_by_type.doc: Get all proposals of a specific type

get_proposals_by_status.doc: Get all proposals with a specific status

registry_type.doc: Registry type discriminator (ecosystem, proof of creativity, platform).

calculate_vote_cost.doc: Calculate cost for additional votes beyond the first free vote

is_delegate.doc: Check if an address is a delegate

is_delegate_term_expired.doc: Check if delegate term has expired

reject_proposal_manually.doc: If more than half of delegates reject, reject the proposal manually (ecosystem / proof-of-creativity only).

create_platform_governance.doc:
Create a platform-specific governance registry when a platform is approved
 This function can only be called by the platform toggle_platform_approval function
 The transaction sender is seeded as the founding delegate (same pattern as `bootstrap_init`).

last_delegate_panel_boundary_epoch.doc: Largest `k * delegate_term_epochs` boundary for which a full delegate panel election has been applied.

migrate_registry.doc: Public entry function that migrates registry to the latest version

create_spot_governance_registry.doc: One-time admin path for existing networks that bootstrapped before the SPoT registry existed.

create_governance_admin_cap.doc:
Create a GovernanceAdminCap for bootstrap (package visibility only)
 This function is only callable by other modules in the same package

GovernanceAdminCap.doc: Admin capability for Governance system management

GovernanceDAO.doc: Governance registry that keeps track of all delegates and proposals

registry_type.doc: Registry type identifier (ecosystem, proof of creativity, platform)

nominated_delegates.doc: Treasury for proposal costs and rewards

last_delegate_panel_boundary_epoch.doc: Largest epoch boundary `k * delegate_term_epochs` for which a full panel election has run (`0` = none yet).

Delegate.doc: Delegate struct representing a member of the delegate council

NominatedDelegate.doc: Nominee struct representing a user nominated but not yet active

Proposal.doc: Proposal struct representing a governance proposal

Vote.doc: Vote struct for tracking individual votes - unused fields removed

DelegateElectedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a new delegate is elected

DelegateNominatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a user is nominated to become a delegate in a future term

DelegateVotedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a delegate or nominee is voted for/against

DelegateVoteClearedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a user clears their delegate/nominee up or down vote

ProposalSubmittedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is submitted

DelegateVoteEvent.doc: Event emitted when a delegate votes on a proposal

CommunityVoteEvent.doc: Event emitted when a community member votes on a proposal

AnonymousVoteEvent.doc: Event emitted when an anonymous vote is submitted

ProposalApprovedForVotingEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is approved by the delegate council

ProposalRejectedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is rejected by the delegate council

ProposalApprovedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is approved by the community

ProposalRejectedByCommunityEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is rejected by the community

ProposalImplementedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is implemented

ProposalRewardPoolForfeitedToTreasuryEve.doc: Failed proposal pool sent to a treasury (ecosystem or platform governance) instead of the submitter.

ProposalImplementationRewardToSubmitterE.doc: Approved proposal: reward pool sent to the submitter when marked implemented.

VoteDecryptionFailedEvent.doc: Event emitted when vote decryption fails

ProposalRescindedEvent.doc: Event emitted when a proposal is rescinded by its submitter

GovernanceParametersUpdatedEvent.doc: Event emitted when governance parameters are updated

GovernanceRegistryCreatedEvent.doc:
Event emitted when a governance registry is created
 This event matches the GovernanceRegistryEvent structure expected by the indexer

DelegatePanelRefreshedEvent.doc:
Event emitted when a delegate panel refresh applies a completed term boundary
 (`last_delegate_panel_boundary_epoch` on the DAO).
